neutral.EN: Is that supposed to bother me?
neutral.TL: Iniisip mo bang maaapektuhan ako riyan?

neutral.EN: You will have to do better than that.
neutral.TL: Kailangan mong galingan kaysa riyan.

neutral.EN: I have heard worse from better people.
neutral.TL: Nakarining na ako ng mas masakit sa mas matitinong tao.

neutral.EN: That did not even scratch me.
neutral.TL: Ni hindi ako nagasgasan sa sinabi mo.

neutral.EN: Save your breath. It does not work.
neutral.TL: Huwag mong sayangin ang laway mo. Walang talab 'yan.

neutral.EN: Is that the best you can come up with?
neutral.TL: Iyan na ba ang pinakamagaling na kaya mong sabihin?

neutral.EN: Weak. Try harder next time.
neutral.TL: Mahina. Pagbutihin mo sa susunod.

neutral.EN: Words do not hurt out here. Bullets do.
neutral.TL: Hindi nakakasakit ang salita rito. Ang bala ang nakakamatay.

neutral.EN: You think that gets under my skin? Think again.
neutral.TL: Akala mo ba tatablan ako niyan? Mag-isip ka ulit.

neutral.EN: Not impressed.
neutral.TL: Hindi ako humanga.

neutral.EN: You are barking up the wrong tree.
neutral.TL: Maling tao ang binabangga mo.

neutral.EN: You are picking a fight you cannot win.
neutral.TL: Naghahanap ka ng away na hindi mo kayang ipanalo.

neutral.EN: You really picked the wrong person to cross.
neutral.TL: Maling-mali ang taong napili mong galitin.

neutral.EN: Careful. You are playing with someone who will bite back.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka. Lalaban ang binabangga mo.

neutral.EN: You do not know who you are dealing with.
neutral.TL: Hindi mo alam kung sino ang kaharap mo.

neutral.EN: Wrong move, friend.
neutral.TL: Maling diskarte 'yan, kaibigan.

neutral.EN: You are treading on thin ice.
neutral.TL: Nasa napakanipis kang yelo ngayon.

neutral.EN: Pick on someone else. I am not the one.
neutral.TL: Humanap ka ng iba. Hindi ako ang papayag sa ganyan.

neutral.EN: You made a very bad choice just now.
neutral.TL: Napakasama ng naging desisyon mo ngayon lang.

neutral.EN: You are pushing someone who does not back down.
neutral.TL: Itinutulak mo ang taong hindi umaatras.

neutral.EN: Save your breath.
neutral.TL: Huwag mong sayangin ang laway mo.

neutral.EN: Not worth my time.
neutral.TL: Hindi sulit ang oras ko sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: Done talking to you.
neutral.TL: Tapos na akong makipag-usap sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: You are wasting both our time.
neutral.TL: Sinasayang mo lang ang oras nating dalawa.

neutral.EN: I am not wasting oxygen on you.
neutral.TL: Hindi ako magsasayang ng hangin para sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: Walk away before you say something worse.
neutral.TL: Umalis ka na bago ka pa makapagsalita ng mas masama.

neutral.EN: I do not have time for childish games.
neutral.TL: Wala akong panahon sa pambatang laro.

neutral.EN: Keep it to yourself.
neutral.TL: Itago mo na lang sa sarili mo 'yan.

neutral.EN: Whatever. Get lost.
neutral.TL: Bahala ka. Lumayas ka na.

neutral.EN: I have real survival to worry about. Shut up.
neutral.TL: May tunay akong kaligtasan na dapat asikasuhin. Manahimik ka.
